implemented.production: Pilot and production builds without explicit demo reject Mock at startup/readiness/SQL/Python/skills/workers; copied or relabelled generated snapshots are rejected by database markers.
implemented.workflow: Current source and persisted evidence are validated at submission, schedules, completion, review, outbox delivery and retest; legacy unverified workflows are disabled.
implemented.historyAndExports: Mock or unknown-provenance historical data is rejected in formal views/downloads; demo CSV has an origin column and watermark filename.
implemented.collection: Additive migration 008 records observed provenance atomically with submissions; legacy samples are not backfilled or accepted for retest.
implemented.audit: Durable SQLite events capture generation parameters, operator, UID, source script hash, timestamps, expiry, counts, content hash and failures; read-only JSON/JSONL inspection CLI.
implemented.cleanup: Preview by default; only registered snapshots with matching marker/hash/device/inode may be removed. Active sources/leases/live PIDs/unknown remote leases, symlinks, hardlinks, file replacement, changed content and SQLite sidecars are protected. Durable intent and quarantine verification support interrupted cleanup recovery.

operations.apply: Same preview command plus --apply; or select the audit generation UUID with --dataset-id

deploymentNotes: Default foodborne/env/chronic snapshots remain Mock; pilot requires genuinely observed replacement snapshots and matching region bindings.
Unregistered legacy Mock databases are not automatically deleted.
Historical jobs/samples lacking provenance require new execution/submission; no automatic observed backfill.
Audit and business history are preserved; no actual source datasets were cleaned during implementation.
Read-only demo scenarios remain covered; these engineering tests do not certify professional efficacy.
